name: f1bre-monorepo
description: Monorepo F1BRE: frontend actual y limites preparados para API y pipeline.

scripts.format:check: prettier --check scripts tests docs backend data_pipeline contracts fixtures index.html README.md STYLE_UI.md package.json && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
